question.problem:
Given the vector $u=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 6 \\ 7 \\ 8\end{aligned}]$, which of the following vectors are orthogonal to $u?$

$$
v=[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 7 \\ 1 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\,w=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 7 \\ -7 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -7 \\ 7 \\ -4\end{aligned}].
$$
question.worked_solution:
We compute the dot product between $u$ and each of the listed vectors:

$$
\begin{aligned}u\cdot v & ={u}_{1}\cdot {v}_{1}+{u}_{2}\cdot {v}_{2}+{u}_{3}\cdot {v}_{3}+{u}_{4}\cdot {v}_{4} \\  & =5\cdot (-5)+6\cdot 7+7\cdot 1+8\cdot (-3) \\  & =-25+42+7-24 \\  & =0.\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}u\cdot w & ={u}_{1}\cdot {w}_{1}+{u}_{2}\cdot {w}_{2}+{u}_{3}\cdot {w}_{3}+{u}_{4}\cdot {w}_{4} \\  & =5\cdot 5+6\cdot 7+7\cdot (-7)+8\cdot (-3) \\  & =25+42-49-24 \\  & =-6.\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}u\cdot x & ={u}_{1}\cdot {x}_{1}+{u}_{2}\cdot {x}_{2}+{u}_{3}\cdot {x}_{3}+{u}_{4}\cdot {x}_{4} \\  & =5\cdot 5+6\cdot (-7)+7\cdot 7+8\cdot (-4) \\  & =25-42+49-32 \\  & =0.\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

Consequently, the correct option is $v$ and $x$ only.
